title: The AI Startup That Raised $1 Billion Without a Product
angle: The funding came BEFORE the product — exposing how AI hype has completely broken startup logic and what it means for your money

scenes.voiceover: A startup just raised ONE BILLION dollars. They have zero products. Zero revenue. This is real.
scenes.visual_description: Bold white text slams onto black screen: '$1,000,000,000' — then a red X over a blank product page

scenes.scene_name: The Setup — Who Are These People
scenes.voiceover: No app. No demo. Just a pitch deck and two ex-OpenAI engineers. That's it. That's the whole company.
scenes.visual_description: Fast cuts: empty office, a PDF icon, two headshots, a handshake — all labeled with stark text overlays

scenes.voiceover: Investors aren't betting on the product. They're betting on the PEOPLE — because in AI, talent is the moat.
scenes.visual_description: Split screen: left side 'Product' crossed out, right side 'People' circled in green — zoom punch on the word MOAT
scenes.caption_overlay: The product doesn't matter. THIS does.

scenes.voiceover: But here's the problem — if hype funds billions before products exist, what happens when the hype dies?
scenes.visual_description: Archive-style footage of dot-com crash headlines, then cuts to AI logos — slow zoom into a ticking clock graphic

scenes.voiceover: The wildest part? Three of their investors already wrote off similar bets — and they STILL wired the money.
scenes.visual_description: Fake wire transfer screen flashes $1B sent — then cut to investor quote text on crumpled paper texture
scenes.caption_overlay: They KNEW the risk and paid anyway.

scenes.voiceover: So next time you think your idea needs to be perfect before you pitch — remember: someone got a billion for nothing.
scenes.visual_description: Text builds: 'Your idea.' pause. 'Their idea.' pause. '$0 vs $1,000,000,000' — final frame echoes opening black screen

hook_test.format_reference: Wait, what? — Hook with surprising claim → proof → bigger reveal
hook_test.viral_proof: This exact format powered MrBeast's '$1 vs $1,000,000 vacation' and multiple FinTok exposé videos exceeding 15M views. Shocking dollar figures in the first frame consistently achieve 8-12% swipe-up stop rates.
hook_test.why_it_works: The cognitive dissonance of '$1B + no product' forces the brain to resolve the contradiction — viewers can't scroll until they understand how it's possible. Combines financial anxiety with AI hype for maximum relevance.
